name: smwmusic-the-field-a-paw-in-my-face
title: The Field - A Paw In My Face
description:
A track from techno artist The Field that features some acoustic and electric guitar samples.
After playing through Casio Mario World a few months ago, I really wanted to port something that would feel at home in its soundtrack and settled on this tune.
It might fit in a forest, athletic, or abstract level.
Not compatible with Blargg/Thunder SFX.
